content_sections.heading: About CRIS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The Centre for Railway Information Systems (रेलवे सूचना प्रणाली केन्द्र) is an organisation of the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, located at Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. This vacancy is a post-retirement assignment in the CN Group of CRIS headquarters at New Delhi (CRIS/HQ/NDLS).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: CRIS has invited applications only from retired Railway/PSU staff. The eligibility for the Project Assistant post, as printed, is: Essential: Employee retired as Sr. Technician/MCM/TCM (Tele) from the S&T department of Indian Railways/Railway Board/Railway PSUs in Pay Level-5/6/7 as per 7th CPC. Desirable: Computer knowledge. Age: The applicant must not be more than 64 years of age on the closing date of the Vacancy Notice. The notice gives no educational qualification and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: as per CRIS norms. The notice does not print an amount. Engagement period: initially for one year. Duty in shift required: Yes. Holiday working, including Saturday and Sunday: Yes.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRIS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The notice states that eligible retired railway employees who are willing may apply in the format enclosed with the notice. Applications must be sent before the closing date, which is 30 days from publication on the CRIS website. Fill in the application format enclosed with the notice (page 2 of the PDF). Attach a copy of the PPO/Service and Experience certificate. The form also asks for a legible copy of the PPO. Sign the application. Send it by Dak, or by email to [email protected] in PDF format. The notice does not name a separate postal address for Dak applications. The office address printed on the notice is Centre for Railway Information Systems, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRIS Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (1) Project Assistant post in the CN Group of CRIS/HQ/NDLS at New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The closing date is 30 days from the date of publication on the CRIS website. Counted from the notice date of 12 November 2026, that is about 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Employees who retired as Sr. Technician/MCM/TCM (Tele) from the S&T department of Indian Railways/Railway Board/Railway PSUs in Pay Level-5/6/7 as per 7th CPC are eligible. Computer knowledge is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CRIS Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The applicant must not be more than 64 years of age on the closing date of the Vacancy Notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CRIS Project Assistant, and how is it fixed for retired employees?
faq.answer: Remuneration is as per CRIS norms. The notice does not print an amount. The application format asks for your last pay level and pay drawn.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed application format and attach a copy of the PPO/Service and Experience certificate. Send it by Dak, or by email to [email protected] in PDF format.

faq.question: Q7. Is the CRIS Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a post-retirement assignment, and the engagement is initially for one year.

faq.question: Q8. Does the CRIS Project Assistant post involve shift and holiday duty?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that duty in shift is required, along with holiday working, including Saturday and Sunday.
